full_judgment: 4. The case of the defendant nos.1-5 is that the suit is not maintainable in its present form and the suit is liable to be dismissed for want of cause auction. Further contending that the suit land is the Government khas land and the S.A. recorded owner did not transfer the same to any person. Abdul Rahman Bepari created a false deed dated 21.07.1970 and R.S. Khatian for .15 Sataks of land wrongly recorded in the name of Abdul Rahman Bepari who had no legal right to transfer the suit land. They prayed for dismissal of the suit.
